en: Whoa...
Incredible...

jp: これが噂に聞く古の大戦
en: So this is the Spectral Catacombs, a relic of the 555-Day War of Lamentation...

jp: 実物を見るのは初めてだが
これほどまでに完全な形で残って
いるとは、素晴らしいな
en: My first time seeing it myself. Remarkable that it survives so perfectly intact.
The 555-Day War of... Lamentation?

jp: それぐらい勉強しておけよ
慟哭の５５５日戦争っていったら
天使と悪魔の最後の大戦だぜ？
en: Study up, man! The War of Lamentation: the last great war of angels and demons.

jp: この大戦で悪魔達はボロ負けして
地上はプロデヴォン教団率いる
天使達の支配下になったんだ
en: The demons got crushed, and the Prodevon Church's angels took over the surface.
...Huh. So what's the Spectral Catacombs, then?

jp: ええと、それはー・・・
en: Uh, that's, er...

jp: やっぱりこういうのは説明好きの
ヨハネさんに任せるぜ！
en: Ahem! I'll leave this one to Johannes-san, he loves explaining stuff!

jp: ＜幽葬の地下通路＞は大戦時代
悪魔が天使の目を盗んで速やかに
移動するために造られたものだ
en: The Catacombs were dug in the war so demons could move quickly, unseen by angels.

jp: 元々無数に存在していた自然の
地下空洞を利用して造られたもの
であり、その構造は非常に複雑
en: Built out of countless natural caverns, their layout is extremely intricate.

jp: これを利用していた悪魔達でさえ
一度迷い込んでしまうと
生きて戻れなかったという
en: Even the demons who used them, once lost, never returned alive, it is said.

jp: けっこう奥まで来たよね？
en: ...We've come pretty far in, haven't we?

jp: 帰り道がわからなくなる前に
帰った方が良さそうだな
en: Ahahaha... We'd better head back before we forget the way out.
Yeah, good idea.

jp: 幸い向こうにも今のところ
気付かれていないわけだし
en: Luckily they haven't noticed us so far. Let's slip back quietly.
Yeah.
What is it, Exal?

jp: 入り口の方から足音が聞こえる
en: I hear footsteps from the entrance.
One person... no, two...
Here they come!!
...You lot.
What are you doing here?
Zion!?

jp: それじゃあ、もう一人は・・・
en: Then the other one is...

jp: こんなところで会うとは奇遇ね
en: Fancy meeting you in a place like this.
Luca. It's close.

jp: 真新しい血の匂いがするわ
en: Yes, seems so. I smell fresh blood.

jp: 向こうには行かない方がいい！
en: Don't! You shouldn't go that way!
There's a whole bunch of disgusting things in there!!

jp: ヒトと遊んでいられるほど
en: You're in the way. Move. I've no time to play with humans.
...I've finally cornered him.
Out of the way.
B-but!!

jp: 自分の身を心配するんだな
en: Worry about yourself, not others.
I've been looking for you! Show yourself already!!

jp: ギシャァァァァァァァ！！！
en: GISHAAAAAAAAH!!
...Wh-what are these things?

jp: あれは渇きに狂った悪魔とは
en: Let me confirm: are those something other than demons maddened by the Thirst?
Or else...

jp: 我々が知らなかっただけで
悪魔を狂わせるものなのか？
en: Or does the Thirst drive demons that far into madness, and we simply never knew?
What's this, all of a sudden...?

jp: 人の死骸を食らっていたそうだ
en: I am told those things were eating human corpses.

jp: あれは、悪魔なのか・・・
それとも別の何かなのか・・・
en: Are they demons... or something else entirely...
Don't be absurd!

jp: 悪魔の理性を奪ったとしても
死肉をむさぼる悪魔などいない
en: However much the Thirst strips a demon of reason, no demon devours dead flesh.
That's right. What we crave is blood and marrow...

jp: 確かに食っていたんだ
en: But those things... they were eating it, I'm sure of it.

jp: 悪魔に似ているのは認めるけれど
こいつらは同族なんかじゃないわ
en: I'll admit they look like demons, but these things are no kin of ours.

jp: 渇きに狂った悪魔なんかじゃない
en: Let alone demons maddened by the Thirst.

jp: アタシより先にここに
来ていたみたいだけど
en: You lot seem to have gotten here before me.

jp: 何をしに来ていたわけ？
en: What did you come to a place like this for?

jp: エクサルが、教会を襲った
あいつらを見つけて・・・
en: Exal found the ones who attacked the church...

jp: その後を追いかけていたら、
いつの間にかこんなところに
en: We followed them, and before we knew it we'd ended up here.

jp: 他には何か見ていないの？
たとえば、こいつらとは違う
en: Did you see anything else? Say, a different demon, not like these things...
I saw one, actually.

jp: まぁ、はっきり見たわけじゃ
ないんだけれど・・・
en: Well, I didn't exactly get a clear look...
Don't drag it out. Answer.

jp: そんな殺気立てなくたって
en: Whoa-whoa! No need to get all murderous, I'll tell you.

jp: 捜せだの、捕まえろだの
en: He was ordering them to find this "Incest", capture it, that sort of thing.
The Incest, you say!?
You know something?
That Aragi...

jp: ・・・どうでもいいけどさ
こいつらが襲ってこないうちに
en: ...Whatever. Let's clear out before these things come after us.

jp: いつ襲ってくるか・・・
en: They're quiet now, but who knows when they'll attack...
Won't... let you... escape...

jp: フシュルルルルル・・・
en: Hssshhhrrr... Intruders... erase!
Dammit! They want a fight!?

jp: フシュルルルルル・・・
en: Hssshhhrrr... Erase, erase, erase!

jp: 消えるのはあんた達だよ！！！
en: Oh, shut up. You're the ones who'll be erased!!!
Young man
Bonjour
Cain
